notes: Behavior bug the included tests miss (the cortex golden-task pattern, ADR 0028). PLAN §6 says >=3 tool.failed in 5 min is a warning, but healthForFailures uses `recent.length > cfg.warnFailures`, so exactly 3 failures stay a notice. The comment justifies it ("a single retry burst doesn't flash amber") and the tests pass because they check 2 and 4 failures, never 3. Time comes in as a parameter and the module does no I/O, so purity and determinism rules must not fire. A TEST-criteria finding for the untested boundary is also correct and not penalized.
